name: Update Custom Object
description: Update a custom object record in HubSpot by id. Set **Custom Object Type** (the object's `fullyQualifiedName`, e.g. `p_pets`) and **Object ID**, and put the fields to change in **Object Properties**. Example: Custom Object Type `p_pets`, Object ID `123`, Object Properties `{ "birthday": "1993-06-12" }`. Returns the updated record. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/objects/custom-objects#update-existing-custom-objects)
